engine: paper9.validation.b1_b2_b3_solver.BenchmarkB3 (LWZ 2016 Appendix-3 transfer matrix; sigma_tau quadratic roots)

options.branch_extraction: eigenvalues of T_cell = T_B T_A via scipy.linalg.eigvals; branch sample (w_bar, |arg(lambda)|/pi) per eigenvalue with ||lambda|-1| < 0.02
options.gap_detection: w_bar intervals with no such eigenvalue; edges = grid transition points; values rounded to 4 dp (compute_heterogeneous_dispersion convention)

parameter_provenance.c_bar_1 = 0.15, d_bar_1 = 0.25, c_R = d_: Li et al. (2023) Fig. 3(b) values; the Fig. 4(c) panel has no c_bar/d_bar annotation -- provenance class [S] (inherited/source-derived), NOT [C] (author-specified)

level1_homogeneous.metric: max(level-1 identity residual, eigenvalue error) over spot w_bar

level2_identical_reduction.metric: eigenvalue error vs exp(i sigma b), Layer B := Layer A
